I have built **TaskFlow**, a modern, responsive to-do and productivity application.

### 🌐 Preview Your App
You can open and test the live application here:
**[View Live To-Do App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/8ab7f94d-6bef-4644-9131-7721aa970c9a/b43c851918374a34a320baeb/)**

---

### Key Features
- **Task Organization**: Create, edit, star, prioritize (High, Medium, Low), and organize tasks by category (Work, Personal, Shopping, Health, Learning, or custom categories).
- **Smart Views**: Instant filtering across **All Tasks**, **Today**, **Upcoming**, **Starred**, and **Completed**.
- **Subtasks & Notes**: Break down complex tasks into checklists with live progress indicators.
- **Built-in Pomodoro Timer**: Switch between Focus (25m), Short Break (5m), and Long Break (15m) sessions linked directly to your tasks.
- **Micro-Interactions & Audio**: Procedural Web Audio API sound feedback, milestone confetti celebrations, and a dark/light theme toggle.
- **Productivity Dashboard**: Daily progress bar, completion rate tracking, and breakdown by priority and category.
- **Backup & Portability**: Export and import data via JSON and persistent `localStorage`.
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: `N` for new task, `/` or `Ctrl/Cmd + K` to search, `P` for Pomodoro, and `D` for theme toggle.

### Project Files
- [index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html) — Application structure, views, modals, and responsive layout.
- [app.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/app.js) — Task state management, filters, audio synthesizer, confetti engine, and timer logic.
- [styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/styles.css) — Custom animations, styling, and scrollbar polish.
- [README.md](file:///home/agent/workspace/README.md) — Documentation and keyboard shortcuts reference.
I am currently running on **Gemini 3.8 Flash**.
